fact.thing: SOXL fall from its June 22, 2026 all-time high (Nov 4 close)
fact.box: Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares (SOXL), a US-listed ETF
fact.claim: At the November 4, 2026 close, SOXL was 77.8% below its June 22, 2026 all-time high, so $1,000 bought at that peak would be worth about $222. Over the same stretch the unleveraged chip ETF SOXX fell 31.19%, because SOXL resets its 3x leverage every day and losses compound. On November 5 SOXL dropped another 26.2% in morning trading to $49.18, so it is deeper now, but no closing figure for today was published yet. The last time it fell this far (-90.5% from December 2021 to October 2022), it did not reach a new price high until April 10, 2026, about 4.3 years after the old peak, and past recoveries are no promise of a future one.
